diagnosis.what_happened: Conversational report was emitted in Persian instead of English.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Context bleed from processing Persian artifacts caused the agent to switch output language.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The agent should have maintained English for all system and user dialogue regardless of artifact language.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Orchestration language must be decoupled from artifact language to maintain standard user protocol.

desired_behavior: Maintain strict English language for all user-facing dialogue, stage completion reports, and orchestrator messages.
generalization: Never switch conversation interface language to match the document artifact's language unless explicitly requested by the user.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero tolerance for conversational language bleed.
